newsitem.title: GUADELOUPE: Port conditions update-Guadeloupe- Lloyds Shipping.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update-Guadeloupe- Lloyds Shipping.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

GUADELOUPE, June 16 - Stevedore dispute. No negotiation is underway. From time to time the stevedores are blocking either the unloading of the vessels or the port. Today the entrance of the port has been blocked by containers placed in middle of the way. The CGM vessel on quay today cannot be unloaded.
